territories.name: Perlis
territories.conviction_method: v2: 60% worst-pair model agreement + 40% EC ENS relative spread
territories.diagnosis: Operational Day 1–5 drier bias: EC Hybrid (8.7 mm/day) sits below the 14-day ensemble consensus (9.6 mm/day). Moderate Harvesting Impact: Wet estate conditions (8.7 mm/day) with periodic afternoon downpours; minor delays in FFB transport, though soil moisture replenishment remains favorable.
